name: When should I consider a safety upgrade for my laundry room?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider a safety upgrade for my laundry room?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider a safety upgrade if you notice signs of lint accumulation, water leaks, flickering lights, burning smells, or if your appliances are old. Upgrading is also recommended during a remodel, after purchasing new appliances, or if you're increasing the usage of your laundry space. Proactive upgrades can prevent costly damage and ensure the well-being of your household. Regular inspections can identify potential issues early.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider an upgrade if you see lint buildup, leaks, electrical issues, or during a remodel. Proactive upgrades prevent damage and ensure safety.
